80400acfa3adcc13062344ded3269d7e.overview: Many loosely connected characters cross paths in this film, based on the stories of Raymond Carver. Waitress Doreen Piggot accidentally runs into a boy with her car. Soon after walking away, the child lapses into a coma. While at the hospital, the boy's grandfather tells his son, Howard, about his past affairs. Meanwhile, a baker starts harassing the family when they fail to pick up the boy's birthday cake.
80400acfa3adcc13062344ded3269d7e.tagline: From two American masters comes a movie like no other

804af2e76829b2734877af52032a5370.overview: The circularity of violence seen in a story that circles on itself. In Macedonia, during the war in Bosnia, Christians hunt an ethnic Albanian girl who may have murdered one of their own. A young monk who's taken a vow of silence offers her protection. In London, a photographic editor who's pregnant needs to talk it out with her estranged husband and chooses a toney restaurant.
804af2e76829b2734877af52032a5370.tagline: Time Never Dies, the Circle is Not Round.

805dc4c929755fc74ca59aee4ed81359.overview: Domingos is a member of an African liberation movement, arrested by the Portuguese secret police, after bloody events in Angola. His wife goes from a prison station to another, trying in vain to find out where he is.

806b5a83cd05fbdb7fbdea3dc2813895.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

8077d9ef6d7b77be40e432efe5fff91b.overview: This documentary about teenagers living on the streets in Seattle began as a magazine article. The film follows nine teenagers who discuss how they live by panhandling, prostitution, and petty theft.
8077d9ef6d7b77be40e432efe5fff91b.tagline: The streets - your only chance for life.

808c8790b6da5d2b5754fe1930ccbdc1.overview: An epic that details the checkered rise and fall of French Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte and his relentless journey to power through the prism of his addictive, volatile relationship with his wife, Josephine.
808c8790b6da5d2b5754fe1930ccbdc1.tagline: He came from nothing. He conquered everything.

808fccb61465b99ff4be1f634ab044c7.overview: Humbert Humbert is a middle-aged British novelist who is both appalled by and attracted to the vulgarity of American culture. When he comes to stay at the boarding house run by Charlotte Haze, he soon becomes obsessed with Lolita, the woman's teenaged daughter.
808fccb61465b99ff4be1f634ab044c7.tagline: How did they ever make a movie of Lolita?

809de9e01466a39121f06f0f65815ac4.overview: "Boxcar" Bertha Thompson, a transient woman in Arkansas during the violence-filled Depression of the early '30s, meets up with rabble-rousing union man "Big" Bill Shelly and the two team up to fight the corrupt railroad establishment.
809de9e01466a39121f06f0f65815ac4.tagline: Life made her an outcast. Love made her an outlaw.

80a611acf6449023301336fec04dc822.overview: A dramatic history of Pu Yi, the last of the Emperors of China, from his lofty birth and brief reign in the Forbidden City, the object of worship by half a billion people; through his abdication, his decline and dissolute lifestyle; his exploitation by the invading Japanese, and finally to his obscure existence as just another peasant worker in the People's Republic.
80a611acf6449023301336fec04dc822.tagline: 1500 slaves. 353,260,000 royal subjects. Warlords. Concubines. And 2 wives. He was the loneliest boy in the world.

80afd190b0ab4c43c9eb4fc58f41cac3.overview: A filmed version of Aaron Copland's most famous ballet, with its original star, who also choreographed.

80b9275a76bee921a486582e6b2c75bc.overview: Davey Gordon, a New York City boxer at the end of his career, falls for dancer Gloria Price. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo, who has eyes for Gloria. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.
80b9275a76bee921a486582e6b2c75bc.tagline: Her Soft Mouth Was The Road To Sin-Smeared Violence!

80c4d671fa7ad3261a561dd046a8b206.overview: In a small, conservative Scottish village, an oilman is paralyzed in an accident. His wife, who prayed for his return, feels guilty; even more, when he urges her to have sex with another.

80cb81f03f02cc9e0107f3fd28877e25.overview: When an arranged marriage brings Ada and her spirited pre-teen daughter Flora to the wilderness of 19th-century New Zealand, she finds herself locked in a battle of wills with both her controlling husband and a rugged frontiersman to whom she develops a forbidden attraction.
80cb81f03f02cc9e0107f3fd28877e25.tagline: Silence affects everyone in the end.
